title: Claude Code Tresor Skill Frontmatter
description: Schema for SKILL.md YAML frontmatter. Skills are autonomous helpers with limited tool access.

name.description: Skill identifier, kebab-case. Must match directory name.

description.description: Triggers and use cases. Read by Claude to decide when to activate.

allowed-tools.description: Comma-separated tool names. Recommended set per CLAUDE.md: Read, Write, Edit, Grep, Glob. Bash is broader access and should be justified.
